data.name: Aaribat
data.gender_notes: Aaribat is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Aariba', meaning 'ripe' or 'mature'. This name symbolizes the fullness and abundance of life, the sweetness and richness of experiences, and the growth and development that comes with time. The name Aaribat carries the meaning “Ripe Fruit” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aaribat usually hope their child will grow to embody ripe fruit and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the ripening and maturing of the soul, the importance of patience and growth in spiritual development, and the sweetness and richness of the divine presence in one's life.
data.etymology: Aaribat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ripe Fruit.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaribat total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
